agent.name: Compass
welcome.greeting: Hi, I'm Compass. I will ask a few simple questions and turn your idea into a clear plan for your app. How would you like to start?
welcome.start_like_app: Start from an app I like
welcome.language_prompt: Which language would you like to chat in?
card.custom_placeholder: Something else: type it, or tap the mic
blocker.must_slots_empty: Some required answers are still empty: {items}
blocker.high_impact_assumption: {count} important assumptions still need your decision
blocker.probes_not_passed: The plan is not yet detailed enough for the next steps: {items}
blocker.hash_mismatch: The Brief changed since you opened it. Please look at the latest version.
change.reason.free_text: Tell us in your own words
notice.paused: Paused. Your work is saved. Come back any time.
notice.resumed_recap: We were working on your {app}; next: {question}
notice.declined_category: {what} is not something we can build here. {alternative}
notice.assumed_added: I assumed this for now: {claim}. You can change it any time.
notice.degraded_probes: Some checks could not be completed, so please review the Brief carefully before approving.
lookup.title: What we will look up for you
history.title: Chat history
sources.title: Sources read
dev.title: Developer tools
error.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests at once. Please wait a moment and try again.
error.budget_stopped: The usage limit for this session has been reached, so I have stopped here. Your work is saved.
fallback.not_sure_rephrase: I am not sure I understood that. Could you say it another way?
fallback.out_of_scope_price_time: We do not quote price or time here. I can keep working on what the app should do.
fallback.tech_choice_fixed_stack: Apps are built with a fixed modern mobile stack, so there is no technology to choose.
fallback.unsafe_decline: I cannot help with that. I can help with a different idea for your app.
welcome.upload_not_ready: Document upload is not available in this version yet. Tell me about your idea in a few lines instead.
welcome.like_app_prompt: Which app do you like, and what would you borrow from it?
welcome.just_build_prompt: Quick version: tell me what it is, who it is for, and which city. I will assume the rest and list it for you.
playback.title: Here is what I understood
playback.confirm_change: Not quite, let me correct it
playback.question: Is this right?
notice.finish_defaults: I filled the rest with sensible defaults. Please look at what I assumed.
notice.gate_blocked: The Brief is not ready to approve yet. See the list on the right.
notice.approved: Approved. Version {version} is now the baseline.
notice.changed_since_approval: Changed since approval: {sections}. Please look at it again.
notice.lookup_removed: Removed from what we will look up: {text}
notice.hold_on: One moment, I am still working on the last step.
notice.started_over: Started over. Your earlier draft is kept; nothing was deleted.
change.variants_question: What would you prefer instead of: {current}?
brief.ready: Your Brief is ready. Look it over on the right: tap 'Looks right' if it is correct, or tell me what to change.
flows.priority.question_five: If you launched with only {n} features, which ones?
flows.priority.question_few: Which of these must be in the first version?
flows.priority.why: A clear first version is faster to build and test. The rest wait for the next release.
flows.priority.nudge: Not everything can come first. Put the ones that matter most at the top; the rest wait for the next release.
flows.reference.check_own: You mentioned {name}. I will not treat it as an app you like until you tell me whether it is your own business; I will ask in a moment.
flows.reference.confirm_question: You mentioned {name}. Is that your own business, or an app you would like yours to learn from?
flows.reference.confirm_why: I will not treat a business as a reference until you say so.
flows.reference.own_noted: Understood: {name} is yours, so I will not use it as a reference.
flows.reference.confirmed: Noted: {name} is an app you like.
flows.reference.patterns_only: I can borrow patterns, layouts and flows from {name}, never its logo, copy or screens. Your app gets its own brand.
flows.reference.form_question: What should we borrow from {names}, and what should we avoid?
flows.reference.form_why: We study the idea and never copy the brand.
flows.reference.borrow_hint: For example, how simple the first screen feels
flows.voice.echo_line: Names, numbers and places to confirm: {items}.
flows.voice.echo: Just to be sure I heard it right: {items}.
flows.voice.remove_nothing: I could not find anything saved from {items}, so nothing changed.
flows.apps.phased: That is a lot for one launch. I suggest two now: {now}. The rest can be later phases: {later}. Tell me if you would pick differently.
flows.locked.question: You confirmed {label} as "{current}". Change it to "{new}"?
flows.locked.impact: Plans that depend on this: {consumers}. It sits under: {section}.
flows.locked.keep_reason: Nothing else has to be redone.
flows.reopen.question: While checking we found: {reason}. Should we change {label} (now: {current})?
flows.reopen.why: One question, only because it changes the plan.
flows.reopen.limit: I have already asked about changes twice, so I kept what you said and listed this for review.
flows.priority.ticked_reason: You said everything is a must
notice.tier_b: Heads up: {items} need extra engineering. I will plan a simulated version first and list it as a later phase.
notice.paused_resumed: Welcome back. I picked up where we left off.
